segments.name: Vessel and offshore operations
segments.description: An international ship-owning and chartering company that charters vessels and offshore assets to customers under long-term, fixed-rate contracts.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as a single reportable segment, primarily generating revenue from long-term, fixed-rate charters.

revenueModel.text: Charterers such as Maersk, Volkswagen, Trafigura, Hapag Lloyd and ConocoPhillips pay the company fixed rates under long-term time charter and drilling contracts.
revenueModel.evidence: primarily generating revenue from long-term, fixed-rate charters. Additional revenue sources include sales-type lease interest income, voyage charter and pool revenues, and drilling contract revenues.
